scope: English report delivery, saved evidence and offline tool validation only

mainnetTools.command: node --import tsx --test live-test/*.test.mjs mainnet-test/*.test.mjs mainnet-recovery/*.test.mjs mainnet-pool/*.test.mjs mainnet-funding/*.test.mjs mainnet-completion/*.test.mjs mainnet-observe/*.test.mjs mainnet-rewards/*.test.mjs mainnet-entitlement-transfer/*.test.mjs mainnet-entitlement-transfer/audit/*.test.mjs

gitEvidenceWhitespacePolicy: Ten captured JSON outputs retain original trailing blank lines. For the evidence commit only, diff --check uses core.whitespace=-blank-at-eof; no evidence bytes were normalized. All other whitespace checks remain enabled.
